subject: Follow-up: costing deep-dive & term options for Atlas Labs
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@atlaslabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: costing deep-dive & term options for Atlas Labs

Hi Samira — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can size a clear pricing proposal: 

1) Recap of what you shared
- Pilot scope: chat + embeddings for search + reranking on user queries; ~3 product teams initially (search, answers, recommendations).
- Current baseline: ~80M tokens/month today across staging + prod; expected growth to ~400M tokens/month by month 6 after launch cadence. You expect 60% of traffic to be generation (chat) and 40% embeddings/rerank.
- Budget range you mentioned on the call: $8k–$25k/month while you prove product-market fit, with willingness to discuss committed pricing for lower unit economics.

2) What we need from you (one-pagers or quick numbers is fine)
- Confirm steady-state token projection for months 1, 3, and 6 (approximate is fine).
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a goal of ~$8 per 1M tokens as an anchor — can you confirm if that’s target or ceiling?
- Any procurement calendar constraints (PO timing / quarter-end approvals)?

3) What we can offer in the next note
- Indicative committed-use bands (monthly tokens) with unit $/1M and incremental multi-year rebate options.
- Startup program credits we can evaluate (conditional on company stage / cap table).
- Quick SOW + timeline for pilot rollout and suggested model configuration to hit your latency/cost targets.

Sending an empty template for your token forecast and attaching our current pricing matrix so you can see how bands shift with commit. If you prefer, Ben can run a short session to walk the model and show the unit-cost math.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers and any notes on procurement timing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126
Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. Per our convo, sharing the rough projections so you can run numbers: see attached Excel. Quick notes: 

- Token projections (approx):
  • Month 1: 120M tokens (pilot public beta)
  • Month 3: 260M tokens (expanded beta + marketing push)
  • Month 6: 420M tokens (full prod for initial geos)

- Cost target: we are evaluating options but want to get below $10 / 1M tokens as a working target; $8 / 1M would be ideal if we can get a committed path or startup credits.
- Procurement: procurement approval window is ~3–6 weeks after commercial terms are agreed; we can issue PO in July if terms are finalized by end of June.
- Eligibility: we are a seed-stage company (raised $5.2M in seed). Interested in the startup program and any acceleration credits for the pilot.

Attachments: Atlas_Q2_usage_estimate.xlsx (token forecast + rough spend matrix).

Can you include an initial committed-tier structure that shows: list price vs 6-month commit vs 12-month commit (and any multi-year rebates)? Also send any program requirements for startup credits (term, cap table thresholds, or revenue thresholds).

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan

Best,

Subject: RE: Follow-up: costing deep-dive & term options for Atlas Labs

Internal math — sharing my quick take before I finalize the workbook. Copying assumptions so the commercial note is explicit.

Assumptions from Atlas forecast: M1=120M, M3=260M, M6=420M. We'll use a blended generation/embedding split to get equivalent token charge.

Scenario A — No commit (list):
- List $/1M: $18.00 (our public hosted baseline for the model family + infra premium)
- Month 6 spend at 420M tokens ≈ 420 * $18 / 1M = $7,560 

Scenario B — 6-month commit band (10% discount tier headroom):
- Effective $/1M: $16.20 (10% off)
- Month 6 spend ≈ 420 * $16.20 = $6,804

Scenario C — 12-month commit band + startup credits (aggressive path):
- Base commit price: $14.40 / 1M (20% off list)
- Startup credit: equivalent to 3 months free on first-year consumption (~25% effective uplift for year 1) — conditional on stage/cap table
- Effective Year-1 $/1M (after credits averaged) ≈ $10.80 / 1M (target territory close to $8–$10 if we layer additional multi-year rebate)

Recommendation: propose a 12-month commit with a staged rebate: 15% off at contract signature (baseline), additional 5% after hitting 6mo consumption milestone, and a one-time startup credit that brings Year-1 blended to target range. This preserves list economics but shows a clear path to Atlas's $8–$10 target if they commit to a 12-month cadence and accept staggered rebate milestones.

Action items for the commercial note (Ben):
- Build a 3-tab workbook: list vs 6mo commit vs 12mo commit + credit and show month-by-month burn and blended $/1M.
- Draft a candidate term sheet with PO timing to enable July invoice.
- Flag any legal SOW items for Marissa (data retention, KMS, audit logs).

I'll attach the workbook and share before EOD.

—Ben
